steps.name: teacher introduction
steps.until: quest:GetStateBool('DoneIntro') and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()

steps.name: donate and verify book zero
do: local key=quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,0); assert(key~=''); if not quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookDonated',0) and not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()) then quest:GiveHeroObject(key,1) end; assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookDonated',0) or quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()), 'book grant not observed'); Runner.grantChecked=true
steps.until: quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookDonated',0) and quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==1 and not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook') and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence() and not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,0),quest:GetHero())

steps.name: verify and save actual donation
do: assert(quest:GetStateBool('DoneIntro')); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksInGame')==40); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==1); assert(quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==1); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook')); assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,0),quest:GetHero()), 'donated book still in inventory'); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==(i==0),name..'['..i..']') end end; quest:AutoSave(); Runner.donationSaved=true
